name: iptc
label: IPTC (News/Journalism)
description: International Press Telecommunications Council — news article metadata standard used by all major news organizations

table_notes.iptc_media_item: Root entity for a single news item (article, photo, video); all other IPTC tables hang off this via foreign key. JSONB columns hold language-tagged values per the IPTC Multilingual Text standard.
table_notes.iptc_subject: Classifies the news item using IPTC subject codes (NewsCodes) or custom controlled vocabularies; a single item may have many subjects at different levels of specificity.
table_notes.iptc_location: Records geographic scope of a news item — where it was created, where it is about, or both — using a role discriminator and optional PostGIS point for spatial queries.
table_notes.iptc_asset: Describes a rendition or binary file (photo, video, graphic) linked to a news item, including EXIF camera metadata and GPS capture point.

iptc_media_item.name: id
iptc_media_item.description: Surrogate primary key for the news item row

iptc_media_item.name: guid
iptc_media_item.description: IPTC globally unique item identifier (provider-assigned, persistent across revisions)

iptc_media_item.name: item_class
iptc_media_item.description: IPTC item class URI (e.g. ninat:Text, ninat:Picture, ninat:Video)

iptc_media_item.name: version
iptc_media_item.description: Monotonically increasing revision number; 1 = initial publication

iptc_media_item.name: title
iptc_media_item.description: IPTC multilingual title: {"en": "...", "fr": "..."} keyed by BCP-47 language tag

iptc_media_item.name: description
iptc_media_item.description: IPTC multilingual description/caption: {"en": "..."} keyed by BCP-47 language tag

iptc_media_item.name: slugline
iptc_media_item.description: Short editorial slug used by wire services for internal routing (e.g. SPORT-SOCCER-UEFA)

iptc_media_item.name: headline
iptc_media_item.description: Published headline per language: {"en": "..."} keyed by BCP-47 language tag

iptc_media_item.name: byline
iptc_media_item.description: Author attribution per language: {"en": "Jane Smith"} keyed by BCP-47 language tag

iptc_media_item.name: credit_line
iptc_media_item.description: Provider credit string displayed alongside the item (e.g. © Reuters 2024)

iptc_media_item.name: copyright_notice
iptc_media_item.description: Full copyright statement as required for licensing and legal compliance

iptc_media_item.name: usage_terms
iptc_media_item.description: Plain-text or URL describing permitted uses, embargo periods, and redistribution restrictions

iptc_media_item.name: lang_code
iptc_media_item.description: Primary language of the item as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. en, en-GB, fr-CA)

iptc_media_item.name: content_created
iptc_media_item.description: When the content itself was originally created (may pre-date publication)

iptc_media_item.name: first_created
iptc_media_item.description: Timestamp of the first transmission of this item (wire publication time)

iptc_media_item.name: content_modified
iptc_media_item.description: Timestamp of the most recent content edit or correction

iptc_media_item.name: item_status
iptc_media_item.description: IPTC editorial status: usable, withheld, canceled, recalled

iptc_media_item.name: editorial_office
iptc_media_item.description: Name or code of the bureau/desk responsible for this item (e.g. Reuters/London)

iptc_subject.name: media_item_id
iptc_subject.description: References the news item this subject classification belongs to

iptc_subject.name: subject_code
iptc_subject.description: Controlled vocabulary code (e.g. IPTC NewsCodes: 15000000 = Sport)

iptc_subject.name: subject_name
iptc_subject.description: Human-readable label for the subject code in the scheme's preferred language

iptc_subject.name: subject_scheme
iptc_subject.description: Name of the controlled vocabulary (e.g. medtop, IPTC_NewsCode, custom)

iptc_subject.name: subject_scheme_uri
iptc_subject.description: Canonical URI identifying the subject scheme (e.g. http://cv.iptc.org/newscodes/mediatopic/)

iptc_location.name: media_item_id
iptc_location.description: References the news item this location is associated with

iptc_location.name: location_role
iptc_location.description: IPTC location role: creator (where item was made) or subject (what the item covers)

iptc_location.name: name
iptc_location.description: Place name (city, region, or landmark) in natural language

iptc_location.name: country_code
iptc_location.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the location

iptc_location.name: country_name
iptc_location.description: Full English country name (denormalized for display without join)

iptc_location.name: city
iptc_location.description: City or locality name where the event occurred or item was created

iptc_location.name: geo_point
iptc_location.description: PostGIS WGS84 point enabling ST_DWithin radius and ST_Distance spatial queries

iptc_asset.name: id
iptc_asset.description: Surrogate primary key for this asset rendition

iptc_asset.name: media_item_id
iptc_asset.description: References the parent news item this asset is a rendition of

iptc_asset.name: media_type
iptc_asset.description: High-level asset type: photo, video, graphic, audio, document

iptc_asset.name: file_url
iptc_asset.description: Full URL or object-store path to the binary asset file

iptc_asset.name: mime_type
iptc_asset.description: IANA media type of the file (e.g. image/jpeg, video/mp4, application/pdf)

iptc_asset.name: width_px
iptc_asset.description: Width of image or video frame in pixels (NULL for non-visual assets)

iptc_asset.name: height_px
iptc_asset.description: Height of image or video frame in pixels (NULL for non-visual assets)

iptc_asset.name: file_size_bytes
iptc_asset.description: File size in bytes; used for storage accounting and download estimation

iptc_asset.name: color_mode
iptc_asset.description: Color space of the image: RGB, CMYK, Grayscale, sRGB (from EXIF/ICC profile)

iptc_asset.name: camera_make
iptc_asset.description: Camera manufacturer from EXIF tag Make (e.g. Canon, Nikon, Sony)

iptc_asset.name: camera_model
iptc_asset.description: Camera model from EXIF tag Model (e.g. EOS R5, D850)

iptc_asset.name: gps
iptc_asset.description: GPS capture point from EXIF GPS tags; enables photo-location radius search

iptc_asset.name: taken_at
iptc_asset.description: Shutter timestamp from EXIF DateTimeOriginal (camera local time converted to UTC)

short_description: International Press Telecommunications Council — news article metadata standard used by all major news organizations
long_description: IPTC (International Press Telecommunications Council) Photo Metadata and News Architecture are the global standards for news content metadata, used by Reuters, AP, Getty Images, and all major news organizations. The schema covers news items/articles with IPTC subjects and genres, geographic locations, bylines/credits, and the original media asset (image) with EXIF camera data and GPS coordinates.
when_to_use: Use for content management systems for newsrooms, digital asset management (DAM) for image libraries, or media archive platforms. IPTC metadata is embedded in all professional news photography and required by Adobe Stock, Getty Images, and all major stock photo platforms. Required for press accreditation systems and news wire API integrations.
